policy.name: KAI9000 Admin Google MFA US WARP
policy.decision_model: approved Google identity AND independent MFA AND US location AND WARP/device posture

independent_mfa.meaning: require independent MFA on every Access login

notes: Google is the identity provider; Google Authenticator is the TOTP second factor.
Cloudflare independent MFA is used because Google IdP MFA-method claims are not relied upon by this doctrine.
Device posture may be used instead of or in addition to WARP after a posture check exists.
Do not apply this policy to fdroid.eggiebagelface.art or the public business site.
Location is defense-in-depth and is not a substitute for identity or MFA.
Do not extract browser cookies, Google connector tokens, OAuth refresh tokens, or TOTP seeds.
api_permissions: Access identity-provider administration only when the Google IdP is automated
